function.name: weather_forecast_get_prediction
function.description: Fetches the weather prediction for a specified location and date range, including temperature, precipitation chances, and wind speed. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The geographical location for which the weather forecast is requested, in the format of 'City, State' or 'City, Country', such as 'Berkeley, CA' or 'London, UK'.

start_date.description: The start date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

end_date.description: The end date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

units.description: The unit system used for the weather forecast results.

include_details.description: A flag indicating whether to include detailed forecast information such as hourly data.

Here’s a quick guide to the most popular men’s underwear styles—what they’re good for, how they feel, and some top picks if you’re looking to upgrade your drawer. | Style | What it looks like | Best for | Key pros | Key cons | Brand/Model suggestions | |-------|--------------------|----------|----------|----------|------------------------| | **Briefs** | Classic “Y” shape, snug at the waist, high cut on the leg | Everyday wear, sports, formal occasions | • Excellent support
• Great for tight‑fitting pants | • Can feel restrictive
• Less breathable if made from synthetic | Calvin Klein Modern Briefs, Hanes ComfortSoft Briefs | | **Boxers** | Loose, full‑coverage, low cut | Casual, sleepwear, hot climates | • Breathable
• Comfortable for lounging | • Offer little support
• Can bunch up under tight trousers | Fruit of the Loom Boxers, Jockey Boxer Shorts | | **Boxer‑briefs** | Hybrid: brief‑like front, boxer‑like back | Versatile, active wear, everyday use | • Combines support & coverage
• Minimal visible panty lines | • May still show seams under tight jeans | Tommy Hilfiger Boxer Briefs, Under Armour Tech Boxer Briefs | | **Trunks** | Shorter leg than boxer‑briefs, similar support | Trendy look, athletic wear | • Sleek silhouette
• Good for compression gear | • Not ideal for very loose pants | Nike Pro Trunks, Adidas Performance Trunks | | **Compression briefs** | Tight, elastic waistband, often with moisture‑wicking fabric | Post‑workout recovery, long travel | • Keeps everything in place
• Moisture control | • Can feel too tight after a while | 2XU Compression Briefs, Reebok Compression Briefs | | **Jockstrap** | Supportive cup with a waistband and a thin strap | Sports, gym, cycling | • Excellent support
• Minimal bulk | • Not suitable for casual wear | Under Armour Jockstrap, Nike Jockstrap | | **Boys’ style** | Similar to boxer‑briefs but with a more relaxed waistband | Youthful vibe, casual | • Comfortable
• Trendy | • Might not offer enough support for heavier activities | H&M Boys’ Boxer Briefs, Gap Boys’ Boxer Briefs | ### How to pick the right one 1. **Consider the activity** – If you’re running or doing heavy lifting, choose compression briefs or jockstraps. For everyday office wear, briefs or boxer‑briefs work well. 2. **Check the material** – Cotton is breathable but can retain moisture; blends (polyester + elastane) wick sweat and stay dry. Bamboo or modal fabrics are great for sensitive skin. 3. **Fit matters** – Look for a waistband that sits comfortably without digging into the hips. A “no‑roll” waistband keeps the underwear in place. 4. **Try before you buy** – If possible, test a few styles in-store or order from brands with free returns so you can find what feels best. ### Quick brand roundup | Brand | Known for | Why it stands out | |-------|-----------|-------------------| | **Calvin Klein** | Iconic briefs | Slim fit, smooth waistband | | **Under Armour** | Athletic performance | Moisture‑wicking, compression | | **Hanes** | Budget comfort | Soft cotton, affordable | | **2XU** | High‑performance compression | Medical‑grade compression levels | | **Tommy Hilfiger** | Classic American style | Durable polyester blend | | **Adidas** | Sport‑centric | Lightweight, breathable | --- #### Bottom line - **For everyday comfort**: Go with a pair of high‑quality briefs or boxer‑briefs in a breathable cotton‑blend. - **For workouts or long flights**: Pick a moisture‑wicking compression brief or a jockstrap for extra support. - **If you’re fashion‑savvy**: Try trunks or designer briefs for a sleek look under tailored pants. Happy shopping!
